description:
Adobe Marketing Agent for ChatGPT Enterprise lets you interact with Adobe Experience Platform AI Agents using natural language. Ask questions, get insights, and take action without leaving your workflow. It understands your intent and connects with Adobe solutions like Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, and Customer Journey Analytics to deliver answers that help teams move faster and work smarter. In order to use this app an Adobe account is required, please reach out to Adobe administrator in your organization.

Language Support: AI Assistant is currently supported in English only. Non-English inputs may produce inconsistent or erroneous results.

Personal Data: If you include personal data in your prompts, only add what's necessary and only if you have the right to use it.

defaultPrompt: Fetch top 5 audiences by profile count
